name: std::stacktrace_entry::operator bool

declarations.code: constexpr explicit operator bool() const noexcept;

intro: Checks whether the stacktrace_entry is non-empty, i.e. it represents an evaluation in a stacktrace.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the stacktrace_entry is non-empty, false otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
A non-empty stacktrace_entry can be obtained from a std::basic_stacktrace created by std::basic_stacktrace::current or a copy of such std::basic_stacktrace.

An empty stacktrace_entry can be created by the default constructor.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
